current_claim: A frozen AXM and SCG identity system with canonical mark source, palettes, type rules, constitutions, and immutable releases.
mechanism: Canonical source and frozen release bundles govern mark geometry, palette, provenance, and legitimate downstream rendering.

findings.title: The mark is governed, but downstream product use is not continuously audited against the canonical geometry and token law.
findings.mechanism: A tool may embed, redraw, recolor, smooth, or reposition the mark and still pass its own product tests.
findings.acceptance: Inventory every downstream rendering, hash or reconstruct its coordinates, and fail on unauthorized geometry, palette, smoothing, or provenance drift.

findings.title: Typography and interface grammar have outgrown the original mark-centered freeze.
findings.mechanism: Products now rely on Case Ledger, Signal Sheet, Cream Editorial, and dark analytical surfaces whose display fit, type sourcing, contrast, and responsive rules are not frozen with the same rigor.
findings.acceptance: Cut a governed AXM experience constitution covering type, spacing, hierarchy, modes, semantic signal colors, and allowed section families without editing frozen mark releases.

findings.title: Accessibility and monochrome reproduction evidence is not packaged as a release receipt.
findings.mechanism: Palette intent and source fidelity do not by themselves prove contrast, focus, reduced motion, print, or assistive-technology behavior.
findings.acceptance: Add contrast, monochrome, print, compact-width, focus, and screen-reader reference captures for each current identity flavor.

assets_required: new frozen release for any corrected identity artifact
next_gate: Extend governance from the mark to the complete experience grammar without mutating frozen releases.
